about: Build 167 draft · charter G2 on the same invented conversations as layers-g.

conversations.name: came-back
said: yesterday I felt so much lighter but this morning the knot in my stomach is back
I slept badly and only had toast
so maybe it's just a rough morning
but it still feels like I failed

conversations.name: older-layer
said: the panic about my exams has finally gone
but now I keep thinking about my grandad, who died last spring
I didn't really cry at the time, there was too much going on
it feels strange that it's coming now
maybe I never let myself feel it
I'd like to visit his bench by the river

conversations.name: new-tablets
said: I've been jittery and on edge for about a week
nothing has really changed in my life
well, I did start some new tablets from my doctor
should I just stop taking them?
okay, I'll ask at my appointment
I feel calmer knowing what to do
